name: Fix-Everything Observatory
author: Parker Brown
description: A scrubbable observatory for the Omarchy repair swarm — every issue and PR since day one, provenance-lit, replayed like a media player

barWidget.description: The swarm chip: one glyph in the bar, and a click that opens the observatory — every omarchy ticket as a mote orbiting the repo hive, provenance-lit, with a media-player replay of the whole history and a cumulative flow diagram of the healing.
